exposure: treatment for retained foetal membranes (RFM): intrauterine tetracycline boluses vs. ozone foam
parenteral administration of tetracyclines and NSAIDS
finding: In cows with retained foetal membranes, treatment with intrauterine ozone foam, compared to tetracycline boluses, did not significantly affect the rate of culling from the herd by 200 days in milk.
mod_finding: Cows undergoing cesarean section were excluded from this study comparing treatments for retained foetal membranes.
